scope: Live Master CMS observations after the OMR preview phase. These are sample-specific observations, not complete coverage.

setDetail.layout: One shared passage and all five question cards. Current question has blue border, OMR and deployment controls; other question IDs open another tab. Metadata belongs to the current question.
setDetail.hmlCardSpecification: User confirms original HML preview images should appear. Current blank cards are a user-reported known issue, not intended behavior.
setDetail.deployment: Existing AI question-wizard CMS target shows same version and approval pending, dated 2026-11-04 17:50.

twinModal.candidateRulesObserved: Single questions show non-set disabled state; current item is disabled as self; other members of the same set are addable. No add executed.

sourceModal.behavior: Used sources expose required page and optional question-number inputs; unused sources are disabled. Exact source-code query returns one row. No add executed.

deploymentModal.behavior: No target selected disables submit. Toggling existing target enables it and shows a redeployment warning. Cancelled without deploying.

statusEdit.behavior: Draft and failed are disabled for this approved sample. Initial save opens a confirmation that all set members' statuses change together. Confirmation and edit both cancelled; no final save.

twinGeneration.behavior: COPY is default, AI can be selected, notice says the whole set is generated together. Cancelled. History is empty. No generation executed.

omrPreviewUnresolved.observation: Preview did not open for 2088663 or 2088659 after several interaction methods. No error message captured. Cause unproven; subjective preview behavior remains unverified.

hmlForm.sourceBehavior: Selected active source 22-M-MA-T0-1-0-DCL-MA-2025 via radio and Select; parent source field updated, purpose remained unselected.
hmlForm.unitBehavior: Lookup showed 732 rows and one exact-code result. Clicking the result cell did not apply it. Autocomplete showed suggestions after 3 characters; exact code 22MMAT0KOK1004030000 was selected through its Select action.
hmlForm.cancelBehavior: Cancel opens a confirmation. Discard navigation removed only our unsaved field selections and returned to list. No file was selected or uploaded.
hmlForm.sourceBoundary: Code findings describe client branches only. Server validation, upload, split, retry and registration outcomes were not executed.

hmlApprovedDetail.relationship: Document approval and child question status are separate. All four children display Draft plus registration success in this approved document.
hmlApprovedDetail.mutation: None; no download or child edit was executed in this phase.

hmlDraftDetail.scroll: All 17 cards and footer visited in overlapping scrolls. AX is truncated at 1200 nodes; lower cards/footer rely on screenshots and preserved source.
hmlDraftDetail.cardArrangement: First column #1-9, second column #10-17, rather than alternating row order.

runtimeValidation.behavior: Approve with no paper registration shows required-selection modal; closing it scrolls to registration radios. Locally selected Not registered; no final approval request.

hmlDraftDetail.staticBoundary: Only final modal action submits approval or discard. Select change only removes a CSS class. See source report; not a live server execution.
